name: South Yanshi Outpost
title: South Yanshi Outpost
summary: A starter outpost south-east of Yanshi under giant canopy trees: a domed Sho house, a 28 m Empyrean tower with a green-lit crown, a Life Stone, the Destroyed Portal to Redspire crystal and Empyrean pillars and statues by a marsh to the east.

shots.standingOrder: Hold 4.8 m up 42 m south-south-east of the outpost's Empyrean tower and tilt from its base to its green-lit crown; the lens never moves and nothing is within 10 m.
